mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that negates the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) over a 3-month period signals a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as companies struggle with input shortages and rising costs.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 55% of instances following a 3-month INDPRO drop > 2%, indicating the market is shrugging off the supply shock.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) that exceeds 5% signals a weakening labor market and slowing consumer demand, which will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower in periods following UNRATE > 5% vs. baseline (t-test p > 0.10), suggesting the labor market signal is not predictive of equity performance.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 50% of 20-day periods following FEDFUNDS > 4%, indicating the market is not responding negatively to the restrictive policy signal.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a weakening housing market that will negatively impact consumer spending and S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower in periods following a 10%+ YoY decline in HOUST vs. baseline (t-test p > 0.05), suggesting the housing market signal is not predictive of equity performance.

mechanism_narrative: A flattening yield curve, as measured by the spread between 10-year and 2-year Treasury yields, signals a slowing economy and potential recession risk that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower when the 10y-2y spread is < 50 bps vs. when it is > 100 bps (t-test p > 0.10), suggesting the yield curve signal is not predictive of equity performance.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail sales (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% year-over-year, it signals strong consumer demand that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly higher in periods following 5%+ YoY RSAFS growth vs. baseline (t-test p > 0.10), suggesting the consumer demand signal is not predictive of equity performance.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 50% of 20-day periods following two consecutive months of PAYEMS declines, indicating the market is not responding negatively to the labor market signal.
